events.verdict: Batum (LAC) is moving alongside Williamson's (NOP) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Batum (LAC) legally contests Williamson's (NOP) shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) is already in Murphy III's (NOP) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Murphy III (NOP) contests Leonard (LAC)"s jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Zubac (LAC) is moving alongside Williamson's (NOP) path and the contact during the shot attempt is marginal.
Harden (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pelicans.
Batum (LAC) slightly drifts forward towards Jones (NOP) and the contact during his shot at the rim is marginal.
Jones Jr. (LAC) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Zubac (LAC) lowers his right arm and initiates contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm that affects his play at the basket.
Jones (NOP) makes contact with Harden's (LAC) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Williamson (NOP) as he defends the driving shot attempt.  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.
Harden (LAC) brings his forearm to Bey's (NOP) upper body and does not apply any force, resulting in marginal contact as he releases away to pursue the rebound.

Fears (NOP) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Leonard's (LAC) hand that is on the ball, as he defends Leonard on the perimeter.  Contact which occurs on the hand of the offensive player, while that part of the hand is in contact with the ball, is legal.
